personalInfo.name: Enes
personalInfo.location: İstanbul, Turkey — open to remote / relocation

about.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 16+ years on the JVM — the last 7+ building distributed, event-driven systems with Java, Spring Boot and Kafka, and since 2022 cloud-native services on AWS and Kubernetes. Architected and built a Kafka-based microservices platform (28 services) that sustained 100K TPS in load tests and in production, and split a monolith into five independently deployable services. Team Lead and Scrum Master who has led and mentored teams of up to 10. For the past ~2 years, has practiced agentic development (AI-assisted engineering) with AI coding agents and the Claude API.

aiAssisted: Agentic development with AI coding agents (Claude API)

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineering Consultant
experiences.description: Client: MasterControl — regulated (GxP) quality-management SaaS for life sciences
responsibilities: Owned features end to end across the stack — OpenAPI contracts, Java / Spring Boot 3.x services, Kafka (Confluent + Avro) and AWS SQS/SNS event flows, Kubernetes / ArgoCD GitOps deployment, and a React / TypeScript frontend.
Built cloud-native microservices on a hexagonal architecture with PostgreSQL, event-driven domain events, and the transactional outbox pattern.

Hardened the Scala, config-driven legacy-to-modern data-migration pipeline: made runs idempotent, added file-level verification and audit trails, and fixed special-character and null-safety edge cases.
Implemented tenant-aware features: record-level capture, row-level-security (RLS) authorization filtering, read-model synchronization, and service-to-service permission checks.
Diagnosed and fixed a PostgreSQL connection-pool exhaustion issue, and built per-tenant queue fairness so one tenant's workload no longer starves others.
Backed delivered features with OpenTelemetry / Grafana observability, TestContainers / E2E tests, and security hardening (Snyk, gitleaks).
Applied agentic development across the lifecycle, using AI coding agents (including the Claude API) for design, implementation, debugging, code review, and test generation.

experiences.title: Software Development Team Lead
responsibilities: Led a cross-functional team of 10 (developers, analysts, QA/testers) delivering high-availability web services with Java / Spring Boot, Vue.js, RabbitMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, and AWS (S3, Lambda, Cognito).
Decomposed a monolith into five independently deployable services, improving deployability and team autonomy.
Stood up CI/CD across seven applications (Docker, DigitalOcean, AWS, GitLab CI), reducing release friction.
Raised engineering quality through code review, pair programming, and knowledge-sharing sessions; hired, coached, and mentored junior engineers.

experiences.title: Software Architect
responsibilities: Owned end-to-end architecture of the Kafka-based microservices estate, defining patterns for service decomposition, clustering, concurrency, and fault tolerance to sustain high-availability, high-throughput workloads.
Led design and architecture reviews across the engineering team and drove proof-of-concept evaluations to de-risk and guide new technology adoption.
Mentored senior and mid-level engineers on distributed-systems and microservices design, raising the team's architectural maturity.

Introduced CI/CD with automated, repeatable deployments, changing the team's delivery culture.
Built KPI / observability dashboards (Grafana, Kibana, Elasticsearch) and an Angular + Spring Boot client-server application; developed a Node.js + Vue.js dashboard.
